data.title: Evergr1n House
data.about:
Evergr1n House new project sets a new benchmark for urban living in Dubai by combining cutting-edge design with the tranquillity of green living. Located in the vibrant Jumeirah Garden City, the Object 1 project offers unparalleled access to the city’s iconic landmarks, including Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and La Mer Beach. The fully-furnished apartments are available in studio, 1, and 2-bedroom configurations with top-tier amenities.

In addition to its prime location and luxurious interiors, Evergr1n House in Jumeirah Garden City, Dubai boasts a wide array of amenities designed to enhance the quality of life for its residents. The project includes an outdoor lounge, a clubhouse, a BBQ area, and a swimming pool, catering to both relaxation and socializing.

characteristics_module.title: Discover Evergr1n House: Where Modern Living Meets
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Versatile Layouts: Choose from a range of layouts, from studios to spacious 2-bedroom apartments, tailored to suit every lifestyle.
  • Green Living: The design seamlessly integrates lush greenery throughout the building, creating a tranquil oasis in the heart of the city.
  • Abundant Natural Light: Enjoy spacious units with floor-to-ceiling windows that flood your home with natural light while offering stunning views of both the cityscape and surrounding greenery.
  • Elegant Lobbies: The lobby at Evergr1n House features lush plants and stylish seating areas for a warm and inviting atmosphere.
  • Accessible Parking: Convenient parking spaces designed for the differently-abled, ensuring easy access for all residents.
  • High Appreciation Potential: Situated in the strategically located Jumeirah Garden City, Evergr1n House promises strong value appreciation, backed by upcoming developments in the area.

location_tile.title: Jumeirah Garden City Provides Residents with a Balanced, Active Lifestyle.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Jumeirah Garden City is a residential district located in Al Satwa, Dubai, offering land plots with permits for up to eight-story buildings. Developed by Meraas Holding, the project aims to transform Al Satwa into a thriving vertical community. This medium-density freehold area runs parallel Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), one of the UAE's major highways.
Within Jumeirah Garden City, Al Satwa Park stands out as one of Dubai's premier family parks, featuring dedicated play areas for children, a basketball court, and jogging tracks.

Dubai World Trade Center - 5 Minutes
City Walk - 8 Minutes
Museum of the Future - 10 Minutes
Burj Khalifa - 12 Minutes
Dubai International Airport - 20 Minutes
